_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The signed-in listener's own OffStereo shows, each playable back in chat.

description: Manage the signed-in listener's own OffStereo stories or service playlists. Removing an OffStereo story is a recoverable archive operation, and restore brings it back. Removing an owned Spotify playlist means remove from library because Spotify does not permanently delete playlists; the operation follows an explicit confirmation turn. Apple Music's public API does not expose playlist deletion, so that case returns an honest unsupported handoff. confirm=true records explicit confirmation of the named item and operation.

confirm.description: Records the listener's explicit confirmation of the named destructive operation.

id.description: OffStereo session id or saved playlist id.

name: manage_owned_item

outputSchema.description: Result of managing an owned OffStereo story or service playlist.

status.description: confirmation_required, archived, restored, removed_from_library, unsupported, or auth_required.

title: Manage my library
